rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-4, ONE-KNOB change vs iter-3 (the BEST base: SSIM 0.9723, PSNR 38.19 dB). Knob: image-domain bilateral cascade DEPTH img_n_bf 1 -> 3 (6 -> 12 trainable BF params). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-3 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0005, seed=42, proj sigmas at Wagner-abdomen solver defaults). NUMBERS / TRAJECTORY: iter-1 (defaults) 0.9720 / 38.17 dB; iter-2 (proj sigmas tuned proj_sx=0.01/proj_sy=0.3/proj_sr=0.0005) 0.9680 / 37.90 dB -- proj-domain tuning HURT, reverted; iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.0005) 0.9723 / 38.19 dB -- marginal +0.02 dB. hr=0 throughout (all under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline). FAILURE MODE: the 6-param single image-domain BF, even with img_sr now tightened for edge preservation, lacks the expressivity to add detail back to an already-decent 128-view FBP; it can only smooth, so PSNR stays pinned below baseline. WHY THIS KNOB NOW: the design doc (solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md Design considerations) states 'the image-domain stack readily differentiates into a multi-scale cascade (BF1 mild + tight sigma_r, BF2 wider, BF3 widest)' -- a genuine multi-scale denoiser, not just compounded blur. On demo_dl bilateral, img_n_bf is the confirmed working lever (1->3->5: hr 0.67->0.75->0.77, per mayo_campaign_state.md). The prior amortized img_n_bf attempts were at the LOOSE default img_sr=0.02 where the cascade just compounds a Gaussian blur across edges; now that img_sr is tightened to 0.0005 (iter-3), each BF in the stack is edge-preserving, so a 3-deep cascade should add multi-scale expressivity instead of compounding blur -- the one regime where deepening was previously inert/harmful is removed. HYPOTHESIS: with img_sr=0.0005 making each BF edge-preserving, deepening the image-domain stack 1->3 gives a multi-scale edge-preserving denoiser that recovers fine fibroglandular detail and lifts PSNR toward (ideally above) the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline, moving hr off 0. If FLAT (PSNR within +-0.05 dB of iter-3), this confirms breast bilateral N2I is converging to its 6-12-param structural ceiling (~0.972 SSIM), mirroring Mayo bilateral 0.9462 / dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on their substrates -- the BF inductive bias simply cannot beat a clean dense-view FBP, only approach it. WALL: image-domain BF cost roughly triples (still a small fraction of the FBP-adjoint-dominated per-step cost); step budget unchanged (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800), iter-3 ran 240 s, so well under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
